title: Local Companion
descriptor: A private Windows workspace for personalized AI companions
description_lines: Chat, create images, and manage your companions
and local models in one private Windows workspace.
functional_descriptor: Private desktop workspace for AI companions
role: Chat with personalized AI companions, create images, and manage the local characters and models behind those experiences.
audience: People who run and manage personalized AI companion experiences on their own Windows computer.
brand_idea: A private space for the companions you shape
governing_principle: Keep the owner in control of the workspace, its companions, and its local models.

avoid: claims about content that has not been approved for publication
companion imagery as the product mark
claims of cloud independence beyond the configured experience

assumptions: The owner selected the calm-orbit abstract direction and retained graphite and indigo as the product identity.

The reduced master is used at and below 32 pixels. The full master is presented at 16 pixels for the continuity proof matrix only; its fragmented two-arc silhouette is not a recommended 16-pixel application.
The current app's Segoe UI Variable and Cascadia Mono stack is implementation context. The portable kit uses licensed local fonts.

identity.label: Graphite mark ink
identity.use: Full mark and wordmark on dark surfaces

combinations.label: Local Companion orbit
combinations.use: Split orbit and centered core on graphite

chart_palette.rationale: Indigo identifies Local Companion; derived chart colors remain functional and secondary.

logo.construction: A 512-unit grid anchors two open orbit bands around a circular center. The full master separates a near-white left arc and indigo right arc. The reduced master uses one heavier indigo band and center disc for small applications. All paths are generated from glyphkit primitives in build/mk_paths.py.
prohibitions: Do not substitute the rejected LC monogram or W placeholder packaging icon.
Do not combine companion character imagery with the product mark.
Do not rotate, skew, stretch, outline, bevel, or glow the mark.
Use the reduced master at and below 32 pixels.

guide.idea: A private space for the companions you shape
guide.descriptor: A private Windows workspace for personalized AI companions
guide.foundation: Local Companion brings personalized conversations, image creation, and the local characters and models behind them into one owner-operated Windows workspace. Its product identity belongs to the workspace itself; individual companions and private content keep their own context.
personality: Uses clear space, composed hierarchy, and measured motion
Speaks to the owner's chosen companions and creative work
A fixed character as the product mascot
Names chat, image, character, and model tasks directly
Uses synthetic examples and protects unpublished personal content
Real chats or portraits in generic brand examples
promises: Chat with personalized AI companions from a dedicated Windows workspace.
Create images and organize the characters behind those experiences.
Manage the local models available to the workspace.
in_scope: Product identity, interface guidance, and platform assets
Chat, image, character, and model workflow language
out_of_scope: Private chat excerpts, user files, and local model contents
Companion character art used as the product logo
guide.sharp_edge: Local Companion is the workspace identity. A companion portrait or conversation belongs to its own context and should not become the default product mark or a public sample without separate approval.
guide.logo: The calm orbit places a centered disc inside two open bands. The open shape suggests an owner-controlled space with room for different companions. A thicker Reduced master keeps the same center and opening clear at small icon sizes.
guide.palette: Graphite provides a quiet desktop canvas and indigo carries the product identity. Use the accessible darker indigo on light surfaces. Functional interface cues are measured separately and include text, shape, or control-state cues.
guide.specimen_body: Chat, create images, and manage the local characters and models behind them.
